info.name: Workday Business Process Approvals Process Instances API

description.content:
The Workday Business Process API provides RESTful access to business process management capabilities including initiating workflows, managing approvals, tracking process instances, retrieving process definitions, and handling inbox items. The API enables organizations to programmatically trigger Workday business processes, monitor their status, and integrate workflow automation with external systems.
